title: A blocked uv sync names chantier's holders, waits, never kills
summary: A sync of chantier's checkout never stops what holds its .venv: check, list holders, sync only when none, else go on with 'sync pending' and retry. After 3 min, one line and a For you item; if only its own board and watcher hold it, offer to stop them, sync and restart on the user's yes.
